description.value: HI Vancouver Jericho Beach is a Hostelling International hostel situated steps from Jericho Beach on Vancouver's west side, placing guests directly on the seaside cycling corridor that connects to the Spirit Trail and the Arbutus Greenway. As part of Canada's largest hostel network, it offers budget accommodation in a low-rise setting surrounded by parkland rather than the dense downtown core. Touring cyclists arriving from the Sea to Sky corridor or the BC Ferries terminals at Tsawwassen or Horseshoe Bay will find it a convenient and affordable base on the western edge of the city.
